description: The RegMex project publishes an XLSX input workbook for a German power-system flexibility and sector-coupling experiment. Zenodo lists a public 14.8 MB file under CC BY 4.0. The provider identifies three scenarios, Import, Decentralized and Offshore, and says Germany is represented by 18 regions approximating transmission-operator zones. These inputs could be adapted to compare spatial generation and flexible-sector assumptions in energy-system planning simulations. The archive is a study-specific input set, not an executable model; full configuration is documented in a separate German project report and technology parameters draw partly on earlier project assumptions. The workbook was not downloaded, so units, sheet structure, time-series resolution and internal links are unverified. Round one rejected the deposit as off-topic for energy infrastructure, although its title and description explicitly describe power-sector coupling. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these RegMex scenario inputs.
name: Data input for the RegMex model experiment on the power system and flexible sector coupling
